steps.text: At the park 🌿
I'm at the entrance
The little ice cream stand is open, by the way
You found that before you found me?
I'm gathering useful information
Look to your left
Oh ❤️
{{name:lena}} puts her phone away and walks over to you. She kisses you, then slips her hand into yours. You take the short path through the park, stopping at a bench when your leg starts to tire.
A LITTLE LATER
Come closer. I want a photo of us on this bench.
Like this?
Now you have a photo from our actual park date
Better than the preview last Sunday
Much better. You're in this one with me
My shoulder barely counts
It counts to me
There. Now I want that shoulder back.

You spend a while on the bench together. {{name:lena}} leans against you while you talk, then joins you for another short stretch of the path. Before leaving, you share an ice cream near the entrance.
Ready to go back?
Yeah. I think my leg has had enough walking for today.
Then we're going straight to your place. You can rest before dinner.
And you can keep me company.
That was already part of the plan.
You leave the park together and head directly to your place. Once inside, {{name:lena}} leaves her bag by the sofa and helps you settle with your leg on a cushion.
Better?
Much. Glad we skipped the long loop.
I liked our bench. Especially before that dog tried to steal the next one.
He knew exactly what he wanted.
So did I.
{{name:lena}} sits beside you and rests her hand on yours.
My favourite part was you refusing to let go of my hand to eat.
I managed perfectly well.
You got ice cream on my thumb.
A minor technical problem.
We've got some time before I need to start cooking.
Good. Stay here with me for a while.
I won't argue with that.
You spend the rest of the afternoon together on the sofa. {{name:lena}} keeps the outfit you chose yesterday on, and you let your leg rest before moving to the kitchen.
